branches.fallbackBehavior: Exact-match source calls latestRoundData on the sole nonzero feed, rejects negative answers, and discards the returned timestamps. It has no alternate-feed or age-rejection path; a reverting feed propagates the revert. A zero optional input returns one by construction, not fallback to a second provider. Source reviewed 2026-10-09T10:36:34Z; the configured market identity retains its 2026-10-03 block pin.

collateralParameters.note: Immutable market LLTV per Morpho marketById; this is loan-to-liquidation value, not a vault share mint cap.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Referenced Morpho Blue liquidate checks oracle-valued borrower health against LLTV, transfers seized collateral to the liquidator and requires loan-token repayment. Exact deployment bytecode equivalence is not newly certified.
branches.backstop: No exact-market funded insurance or discretionary rescue commitment was verified in the cited inventory; that fact remains unknown.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Referenced Morpho Blue writes off remaining debt when borrower collateral reaches zero, subtracting badDebtAssets from totalSupplyAssets; VaultV2 NAV recognizes adapter losses. No guaranteed recovery is inferred.
